name: gritive
description: Comprehensive codebase review plugin with 6 parallel review agents covering architecture, refactoring, dead code, performance, security, and frontend. Includes a review-forever loop that wraps any review skill and iterates until its actionable queue is empty, persona-based UX testing, and a project skill that bootstraps a project from an RFP (PRD, design guide, GitHub issues), analyzes implementation gaps, and can burn down the issue backlog autonomously through merge and deploy.
